t: Three names, then everyone with no name
a: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْجِ عَيَّاشَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ، وَسَلَمَةَ بْنَ هِشَامٍ، وَالْوَلِيدَ بْنَ الْوَلِيدِ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْجِ الْمُسْتَضْعَفِينَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ
p: Allāhumma anji ʿAyyāsha-bna Abī Rabīʿah, wa Salamata-bna Hishām, wa-l-Walīda-bna-l-Walīd. Allāhumma anji-l-mustaḍʿafīna mina-l-muʾminīn
m: O Allah, save ʿAyyash ibn Abi Rabiʿah, and Salamah ibn Hisham, and al-Walid ibn al-Walid. O Allah, save the oppressed among the believers.
